A small fix release.

- Long chat titles no longer stretch the sidebar and push the model status dots out of view; they're cut
  off with an ellipsis instead.
- The reasoning summary says "Thought for 1 second" instead of "1 seconds".
- Licensed under MIT, with a new README and getting started guide.

Downloads are unsigned. macOS: right-click the app and choose Open the first time. Windows: SmartScreen →
